Subject: Post-call recap + slot proposals for BlueRiver technical walk-through

Hi Amanda — thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and next steps below.

Recap (key points)
- Primary use case: near-real-time chart summarization and physician note enrichment (latency target ~500ms p95 for short prompts).
- Data constraints: PHI, want VPC/on-prem options for audit logging and KMS integration.
- Success criteria: demo of end-to-end trace showing latency + cost estimates, and discussion of compliance options (SOC2, data residency).

Proposed next step
- Technical walk-through/demo (30–45m) focused on runtime, batching/caching, and deployment modes.

Please confirm which of these works for your team (all times PT):
  • Thu Jul 30 — 10:00–10:45 PT
  • Fri Jul 31 — 13:00–13:45 PT
  • Mon Aug 3 — 09:00–09:45 PT

Who would you like on the call? We recommend: your engineering lead + a security/compliance contact (if available). I’ve CC'd Marissa (solutions engineer) and Karthik (inference eng) to join the demo.

Attachments: discovery-notes-blueriver.pdf (short notes from today's call) and our Redwood one-pager.

If any of those slots don’t work, propose two alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
